prompt: Create an ultra-realistic luxury editorial portrait of a young Black man seated naturally in a honey-brown rattan lounge chair in a stylish living room at night. The subject faces the camera with a calm, confident neutral expression, short neat black hair, clean-shaven face, relaxed upright posture, hands loosely clasped near the lap, one arm resting on the chair, legs comfortably apart. Outfit: minimal all-black casualwear: black crewneck sweatshirt and black trousers, a dark wristwatch on the left wrist, and clean white low-top sneakers. Scene details: exactly 6 prominent decor elements are visible: 1 rattan lounge chair, 1 large leafy tropical plant directly behind the subject, 1 glowing round floor planter with another leafy plant on the left, 1 black arched floor lamp with a warm brass shade on the right, 1 deep teal velvet sofa at the lower right with a small rust-colored cushion, and 1 patterned vintage rug over a wooden floor. Lighting: dramatic studio-quality composite lighting with teal/cyan uplighting behind the plants creating radiant leaf shadows on the wall, warm amber practical light from the floor lamp and glowing planter, soft flattering key light on the face, balanced cinematic contrast, warm-and-cool color harmony. Camera and style: vertical 2:3 full-body seated portrait, eye-level perspective, 50mm editorial photography look, shallow but not excessive depth of field, crisp facial detail, realistic skin texture, natural shadows on the chair and floor, high-end magazine aesthetic. Constraints: no text, no watermark, no extra people, no distorted hands or feet, keep the subject fully integrated into the environment with believable scale, contact shadows, and reflections.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的奢华时尚杂志肖像，主角为 一位年轻黑人男性，自然地坐在时尚客厅的蜂蜜棕色藤编休闲椅上，时间为夜晚。主角面向镜头，表情平静自信且中性，留着整洁的黑色短发，面部清爽，姿态放松挺拔，双手在膝盖附近自然交叠，一只手臂搁在椅背上，双腿舒适地分开。服装：极简全黑休闲装：黑色圆领卫衣和黑色长裤，左手腕佩戴深色手表，脚穿干净的白色低帮运动鞋。场景细节：画面中明确可见 6 个显著装饰元素：1 把藤编休闲椅，主角正后方 1 株大型阔叶热带植物，左侧 1 个带发光植物的圆形落地花盆，右侧 1 盏带暖色黄铜灯罩的黑色拱形落地灯，右下方 1 张深青色天鹅绒沙发配 1 个锈红色小靠垫，以及木地板上 1 张复古花纹地毯。灯光：戏剧性的摄影棚级复合灯光，植物后方的青色/蓝绿色上射灯在墙上投射出绚丽的叶影，落地灯和发光花盆提供温暖的琥珀色实用光，面部有柔和的补光，电影级对比度平衡，冷暖色调和谐。相机与风格：2:3 竖构图全身坐姿肖像，平视视角，50mm 焦段时尚摄影风格，景深适中，面部细节清晰，皮肤纹理真实，椅子和地板上有自然的阴影，呈现高端杂志美学。约束条件：无文字，无水印，无额外人物，无扭曲的手部或脚部，确保主角与环境完全融合，比例真实，具备接触阴影和反射效果。
